items.title: High or Low Thinking? Gemini 4 and Gemma 4 on Hard Math, Cost First
items.summary: Seven models on the 15 problems of AIME 2025 I at their lowest and highest thinking settings, under a hard budget. The top setting cost 2.6 to 4.8 times as much on every paid model; Hydrogen, Carbon and Argon solved all 15 at either setting, and no score change was large enough to rule out chance on 15 problems.
